description: A React component for rendering different types of channel introduction messages in Mattermost, including direct messages, group messages, and channels, with UI elements for favoriting, setting headers, notifications, and adding members.

classes.name: ChannelIntroMessage
classes.description: React component rendering various channel intro messages based on channel type, with functionality for favoriting and header editing.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the current channel.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches total user stats if not already available.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the appropriate channel intro message based on channel type.

methods.name: createGMIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the group message intro UI with participant pictures and notification preferences.

methods.name: createDMIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the direct message intro UI with teammate profile and actions.

methods.name: createOffTopicIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the off-topic channel intro UI with invite options.

methods.name: createDefaultIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the default channel intro UI with creation info and invite options.

methods.name: createStandardIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the standard channel intro UI with privacy info, creation date, and invite options.

methods.name: createSetHeaderButton
methods.description: Returns a button to set the channel header if the channel is not archived.

methods.name: createFavoriteButton
methods.description: Returns a button to toggle favorite status.

methods.name: createNotificationPreferencesButton
methods.description: Returns a button to open notification preferences modal.
